segments.name: Specialty insurance
segments.description: A single specialty insurance segment writing commercial property and casualty coverages through nine underwriting divisions for businesses in underserved and dislocated markets.
segments.evidence: We have one reportable segment through which we offer a broad array of insurance coverages to a number of market niches.

revenueModel.text: Policyholders and cedents pay premiums for specialty commercial insurance and reinsurance coverages written through underwriting divisions on an E&S and admitted basis.
revenueModel.evidence: We are a growing specialty insurance company delivering commercial insurance products and solutions on a non-admitted (or E&S) and admitted basis, predominantly in the United States.
